text: Great app! Used microsoft to do previously, this one is much better even bacis version without web app and sync on more devices. One question: Is there a way to automatically move unfinished tasks in calendar for the next day? For example I have "make cookies" on today's list but couldn't make it..I would like for it to automatically move to next day tasks, until marked as done.
author: Azra Sipović
Miroslav Mrkonjic
developer_reply: Hey Miroslav, thanks for the kind feedback! I put a lot of effort into making it useful and user-friendly. If you're able to please consider supporting my work with a donation or Premium account so I can continue development and keep Tasks advert free. Thanks, Steve
